stem.text: A rubber ball is dropped onto a table and bounces back up. The table exerts a force $F$ on the ball.
Which graph best shows the variation with time $t$ of the force $F$ for the short time that the ball is in contact with the table?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis F and horizontal axis t, origin 0. A straight line rises from the origin.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis F and horizontal axis t. A curve starts on the F-axis, falls to a minimum, then rises.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis F and horizontal axis t, origin 0. A curve rises from the origin to a maximum, then falls back to the t-axis.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis F and horizontal axis t. A straight line falls from a point on the F-axis to the t-axis.
